app.name: PureCalendar
app.description: Modern calendar with day, week, month, and agenda views, and task-aware scheduling.

commands.description: Open the call for the meeting about to start

help.says: Opens the call link for the meeting starting within ten minutes, or already under way. If there’s more than one, you pick.
help.wont: Only opens the link. It doesn’t change the event or tell anyone.

help.says: Shows this week in your calendar.
Reads the words as a date, a time and a title, and opens it as a draft for you to look over.
help.wont: Doesn’t add it to your calendar or invite anyone until you make it active.

tools.name: fn_scheduleBriefing
tools.description: Compile a complete schedule briefing for a date window in one read-only call: resolved calendar settings, daily agenda with local times, overlapping busy conflicts, open working-hour focus blocks, pending drafts and tentative holds, visible scheduled tasks, sync health, and optional keyword search results.

from.description: Start day (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Defaults to today.

to.description: Inclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601, max 62-day window).

days.description: Days to include when "to" is omitted (default 7).

query.description: Optional keyword search included alongside the briefing.

includeFreeBlocks.description: Compute open working-hour blocks per day (default true).

minFreeBlockMinutes.description: Minimum free block minutes to report (default 30).

tools.name: fn_planMeetingSlots
tools.description: Plan up to three ranked meeting times across time zones in one read-only call without needing getCalendarSettings first. Re-reads the user's visible calendars and any teammate team-calendar free/busy, resolves omitted participant time zones from saved contacts when available (never guessing), returns ranked slots with local times, benefits, trade-offs, availability caveats, copyable proposal text, and owner settings. Show options to the user before drafting.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD in owner zone). Defaults to tomorrow.

to.description: Last day inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD, <62 days after from). Defaults to from + 6 days.

participants.description: Participants ({name?, email?, timeZone?}). Uses IANA timeZone if given or resolves from saved contacts (never guessed); teammates (<id>@team.invalid) have team busy checked.

bufferBeforeMinutes.description: Clear minutes required before the meeting (0..240).

bufferAfterMinutes.description: Clear minutes required after the meeting (0..240).

tools.name: fn_auditScheduleHealth
tools.description: Audit a calendar window in one read-only call for double-booked conflicts, back-to-back meeting marathons without buffers, pending or stale drafts, grouped tentative holds, events outside working hours, and calendar sync errors, returning concrete event IDs and next-step recommendations.

to.description: Inclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD, max 62 days). Defaults to from + 13 days.

minBufferMinutes.description: Gap threshold in minutes for back-to-back detection (default 15).

backToBackChainLength.description: Consecutive meetings without buffer to flag (default 3).

tools.name: fn_stageMeetingDrafts
tools.description: Stage private calendar drafts in one write call: place 1–5 conflict-checked tentative draft holds linked by a holdGroupId, confirm a searched meeting option via live recheck (idempotent), and/or release unused private draft holds. Strictly draft-only: never activates events, never emails guests, and strictly refuses to delete any active event.

title.description: Default base title for staged holds.

calendarId.description: Default editable calendar id for holds.

timeZone.description: Default IANA time zone for holds.

holdGroupId.description: Optional group id linking staged holds (auto-generated for 2+ holds).

allowOverlap.description: Allow holds overlapping busy events (default false: conflicts are skipped).

holds.description: 1–5 tentative draft holds ({startsAt, endsAt? or durationMinutes?, title?, calendarId?, timeZone?, attendees?}).

confirmMeetingDraft.description: Chosen slot from fn_planMeetingSlots ({durationMinutes, from, to, startsAt, title?, participants?, bufferBeforeMinutes?, bufferAfterMinutes?}) to recheck live and draft idempotently.

releaseHoldIds.description: Draft event IDs to remove (refuses active or read-only events).

releaseHoldGroupId.description: Group id whose remaining private draft holds should be removed.

keepEventId.description: Event id to preserve when releasing releaseHoldGroupId.

tools.name: listCalendarEvents
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range, returning each event's id, title, startsAt, endsAt, calendarId, status, allDay, timeZone, and recurrenceRule.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 start of the date range to query.

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 end of the date range to query.

calendarId.description: Optional calendar id to filter by.

tools.name: createCalendarDraft
tools.description: Create a draft calendar event. Drafts are private working copies: attendees may be listed but nobody is invited or notified until the event is activated.

title.description: Title of the new draft event.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 start time of the event.

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 end time of the event.

calendarId.description: Optional calendar id to assign the event to.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time zone identifier. Falls back to the system time zone when omitted.

attendees.description: People listed on the event as {email, name?}. On a draft they are visible on the event but receive no invitation until the event is activated.

tools.name: updateCalendarEvent
tools.description: Update fields of an existing calendar event by id, passing only the fields to change. Refuses read-only events and active events with guests unless notifyInvitees is set (which is a release action).

eventId.description: ID of the event to update.

status.description: Optional new status: confirmed, tentative, or cancelled.

calendarId.description: Optional calendar id to move the event to.

attendees.description: People listed on the event as {email, name?}. On a draft they are visible on the event but receive no invitation until the event is activated.

notifyInvitees.description: Set only to tell the event's guests about this change. Telling guests is a release action: an agent cannot do it at any trust level; only a person's own save in PureCalendar, or a CEO approval in the Executive team. Without it, a change to an event with guests is refused.

tools.name: deleteCalendarEvent
tools.description: Delete a calendar event by its id. The event is removed locally at once; a provider-backed event's remote copy is deleted on the next sync.

eventId.description: ID of the event to delete.

notifyInvitees.description: Set only to tell the event's guests about this change. Telling guests is a release action: an agent cannot do it at any trust level; only a person's own save in PureCalendar, or a CEO approval in the Executive team. Without it, a change to an event with guests is refused.

tools.name: rescheduleCalendarEvent
tools.description: Move an existing calendar event to a new start time while preserving its original duration. Refuses read-only events and active events with guests unless notifyInvitees is set (which is a release action).

eventId.description: ID of the event to reschedule.

startsAt.description: New ISO 8601 start time for the event.

notifyInvitees.description: Set only to tell the event's guests about this change. Telling guests is a release action: an agent cannot do it at any trust level; only a person's own save in PureCalendar, or a CEO approval in the Executive team. Without it, a change to an event with guests is refused.

tools.name: activateCalendarEvent
tools.description: Switch a draft event to active. This is the moment listed attendees become real invitees: the next sync carries them to the provider, which sends the invitations. A release action: only a person can do it, by pressing Make active under the event's Stage in PureCalendar, or by approving it as CEO in the Executive team. An agent cannot call this at any trust level; leave the draft for the person and say it is ready.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PureCalendar's extended specialist tools (4 tools across discovery, scheduling, settings) and composite functions (4 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "discovery", "scheduling", "settings").

category.description: Optional category filter (discovery, scheduling, settings, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PureCalendar's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: discovery, scheduling, settings). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PureCalendar's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: discovery, scheduling, settings). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools (call activateCalendarEvent directly).

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
